incident_report.incident: Held up for clear running on the Home Turn.  Sent for sampling post-race.

When questioned regarding his riding out of BINGO BABE to the finish M F Poon stated that under pressure in the Home Straight his mount was inclined to lay in.  He said passing the 50 Metres he commenced to shorten his reins to maintain control of the horse but as he did so he dropped his left rein which resulted in BINGO BABE shifting in and he having to stop riding in an attempt to regather his reins.  He added that as this took some time to do so he was not able to fully ride BINGO BABE out to the finish of the race.  M F Poon was advised he should ensure, wherever possible, that he maintains control of his reins.   Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 200 Metres was steadied to avoid ALL ARE MINE when that runner gave ground.  M Chadwick stated that his mount may not have run out the 2200 Metres of tonight’s event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A Badel reported that his mount raced keenly in the lead and refused to settle.  He said the horse, in his opinion, would be better suited by being dropped back in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of ALL ARE MINE was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race starts.  Before being allowed to race again, ALL ARE MINE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Before being allowed to race again, MEGA FORCE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Before being allowed to race again, PHANTOM CYCLONE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, COUNTRY PRIDE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of RAINBOW SEVEN was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, RAINBOW SEVEN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.
